data.title: Source of underground oil pipeline leak found in Klong Toey
data.description: Thousands of litres of oil are feared to have seeped into drains in Klong Toey district of Bangkok due to a suspected leak in an underground oil pipeline, prompting fire risk alerts.

data.title: Opposition MP ‘Ice’ turns up heat on Bhumjaithai
data.description: People’s Party MP Rukchanok “Ice” Srinork has questioned a budget request by the Department of Special Investigation (DSI), while expressing concern that the person tipped to be the agency’s next chief might not act impartially in the investigation into money-laundering in the 2024 Senate election.

data.title: Two Bangkok schools closed for 3 months over student brawls
data.description: Two vocational colleges in central Bangkok have been ordered closed for three months as repeated brawls between their students have affected public safety and the economy, according to the higher education minister.

data.title: Wildlife smuggling suspects caught with hornbill and gibbon
data.description: Two men have been arrested in Bangkok after allegedly attempting to transport protected wildlife for export, a Rhinoceros Hornbill and a Yellow-cheeked gibbon, authorities said.

data.title: Two men arrested over attempt to smuggle protected wildlife out of Thailand

data.title: Killer of Hua Hin hotel receptionist sentenced to death
data.description: Hua Hin Provincial Court has sentenced a man accused of killing and robbing a hotel employee in January to death, ruling that the crime was so serious and shocking that there were no grounds for leniency despite his guilty plea.

data.description: Malaysia has reaffirmed its commitment to work with Thailand to resolve the long-running southern insurgency, Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said.

data.title: People's Party calls for reform in the House
data.description: The opposition People's Party (PP) has submitted a motion calling for improvements to parliamentary meeting procedures and food services for MPs during late-night sessions, saying lawmakers are often left without food when debates run into the night.

data.title: Airport Link faces temporary extension
data.description: The current operator of the Airport Rail Link may continue running the service after its memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) expires on Sept 30, said Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) Office secretary-general Chula Sukmanop.

data.title: Campus feud sparks talks
data.description: Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation Minister Yodchanan Wongsawat said he would meet police and deans from two rival campuses after students clashed again at Siam BTS station.

data.title: Ekkapob named new govt spokesman
data.description: The cabinet approved the appointment of Dr Ekkapob Pianpises as a government spokesman yesterday, according to deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana.

data.title: Blacklist targets civil service cheats
data.description: The government is tightening measures against cheating in civil service examinations, including a nationwide blacklist of offenders and plans to make the General Examination a fully electronic exam within three years.

data.title: Abhisit grills govt on Land Bridge study
data.description: Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has questioned why the government has continued funding a feasibility study of the controversial Land Bridge project, despite the Finance Ministry acknowledging concerns about its economic viability.

data.title: Navy moves ahead  with frigate plan
data.description: The Royal Thai Navy is moving ahead with its frigate procurement project after the permanent secretary for defence approved the selection result, stressing that the project must deliver benefits to Thailand beyond simply acquiring a new warship.

data.title: Mums demand answers on death
data.description: Two mothers have sought help from the Pavena Foundation for Children and Women over a 17-year-old girl's death following an alleged assault at a rehabilitation centre in Lampang.

data.title: Phuket MP faces 3rd summons
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has summoned People's Party MP for Phuket Somchart Techathavorncharoen to meet investigators next Monday in an inquiry into alleged foreign nominee arrangements.

data.title: Chinese boxing promoter in legal victory
data.description: The Appeal Court on Tuesday acquitted a Chinese boxing promoter of human trafficking charges, citing inconsistencies and doubts in the evidence against him.

data.title: Thailand, Brazil push for stronger economic ties
data.description: Thailand and Brazil are seeking to deepen their partnership as diplomatic relations approach their 70th anniversary, with trade and investment high on the agenda.

data.title: BJT fears renewed turmoil
data.description: The Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) has hit back at former activist leader Sondhi Limthongkul, warning that renewed street protests could drag Thailand back 20 years and undermine investor confidence.

data.title: Sri Lankan workers get nod
data.description: The government recently approved two memoranda of understanding (MOUs) on labour cooperation between Thailand and Sri Lanka, paving the way for the legal employment of 10,000 Sri Lankan workers in Thailand.

data.title: Thai students below OECD PISA average
data.description: Thai students' performance in science, mathematics, reading and computational problem solving remains below the OECD average, according to PISA 2025 results released on Tuesday.

data.title: Govt defends bid to eject Frenchman
data.description: The Interior Ministry has defended its deportation order against French national Kevin Dimino, citing his alleged threats to public order and social harmony.

data.title: Thai clinic linked to penile-filler fatality investigated
data.description: Thai public health officials have opened an investigation into the death of a British influencer who died after receiving a penile filler injection at a clinic in Pathumwan district of Bangkok in March.

data.title: Court orders elimination of invasive blackchin tilapia
data.description: The Central Administrative Court on Tuesday ordered the Department of Fisheries and its director-general to proceed with efforts to eliminate invasive blackchin tilapia from Thai waterways and the Interior Ministry to declare Samut Songkhram a disaster area.

data.title: Thailand’s oldest hippo turns 61
data.description: A lively and heartwarming 61st birthday ceremony was held on Tuesday for Mae Mali, Thailand’s oldest hippopotamus, at Khao Kheow Open Zoo in Chon Buri, with animal lovers and fans gathering to offer best wishes as she enjoyed a special fruit cake.

data.title: Phuket group seeks to stop Jewish New Year event
data.description: PHUKET - A group of Phuket residents on Tuesday demanded a ban on a planned Jewish New Year celebration on the island, saying it would draw conflict to the island amid the continued Middle East war.

data.title: Scammers caught with victim lists and swindle scripts
data.description: Police have arrested 13 scam suspects and seized victim contact lists and swindle scripts at a house in Bang Phli district in Samut Prakan, and also caught a fugitive Korean fraudster hiding in Prachuap Khiri Khan.

data.title: FM Sihasak tells envoy to ensure Israeli visitors respect Thai culture
data.description: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow has asked Israeli ambassador Alona Fisher-Kamm to be more serious about instructing Israeli tourists to respect Thai culture and traditions, to protect bilateral ties.

data.title: No-smoking warning near oil leak on Bangkok’s Rama III Road
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration has warned people not to smoke near drains along a section of Rama III Road because it could ignite an oil leak and cause an explosion.

data.title: Approved state welfare applicants warned to verify ID
data.description: More than 500,000 newly approved state welfare applicants have yet to verify their identities, putting their eligibility to receive benefits from Oct 1 at risk if they do not complete their so-called e-KYC by Sept 30.

data.title: More delays on Airport Rail Link, commuters bused to airport
data.description: Trains on the Bangkok-Suvarnabhumi airport service suffered delays for the second day running on Tuesday, forcing the operator to bus commuters between the city centre and two destinations, including the airport.

data.title: Insurance plan to cover 30 million households
data.description: The Thai government plans to launch a national disaster insurance scheme in October covering 30 million households against floods, windstorms and earthquakes, with the state budgeting about 15.5 billion baht a year for premiums.

data.title: PM Anutin maps path to resilience
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday emphasised the importance of strengthening the country's resilience from within to ensure steady advancement amid rapidly changing geopolitical and technological contexts.
